summary: Kenya's classic trip from the capital to the coast. The SGR train is the comfortable, good-value choice; flying is fastest; buses run day and night.

options.label: SGR Madaraka Express (economy)
options.notes: Runs from Nairobi Terminus (Syokimau) to Mombasa Terminus (Miritini). Express trains are faster than inter-county trains that stop at every station. First class costs more. Book ahead and bring your ID or passport, as tickets are checked at the station.

options.notes: Many buses run overnight. Some cross at Busia and others at Malaba. The bus waits while you clear immigration on both sides. Have your Uganda visa (or EATV) sorted before you travel.
